din653.source: DIN 653 flat/low knurled thumb screw (Raendelschraube, niedrige Form), M6: knurled head diameter dk=24.0, head height k=5.0, on the M6 threaded shank (major dia 6.0) with NO raised shoulder (the head sits directly on the bearing surface). Confirmed vs Westfield Fasteners DIN 653 + GlobalFastener DIN 653 + fasteners.eu DIN 653 (all M6 dk=24, k=5.0), with AFT Fasteners DIN 653 (d1=16/k=3.5 at M4, d1=36/k=8 at M10) confirming the head-diameter series. Drawn as a smooth knurled cylinder (the knurl is a fine feature, omitted like the thread, same as knurled_nut) with a representative 45-degree top-rim chamfer head_chamfer=0.5. length=20.0 REPRESENTATIVE (common M6 stock length); tip_chamfer=1.0 REPRESENTATIVE 45-degree lead. Envelope only — no drawn thread, no knurl, no bore. The DIN 464 high form (same head on a raised collar) is deferred.

din653p.source: DIN 653 M6, app image-variant key — identical knurled-thumb-screw envelope (dk=24, k=5.0), aliases the din653 base.
